findingDetails.title: session-start.mjs calls main() at module scope with no IS_CLI_ENTRY guard and exports nothing, so it cannot be imported without running the hook, and it is the only one of the five session-lifecycle modules with no test
findingDetails.scopeProof: :145 is the only top-level main() call in the five session-lifecycle modules that is not behind IS_CLI_ENTRY, and session-start.mjs is the only one of the five with no export and no test file
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: an IS_CLI_ENTRY guard around :145 plus an export of the composer, which would make the file testable

findingDetails.title: Eight adapters hand-roll the same reply write and four hand-roll the same stdin read, while the shared seam exports a payload reader for one tree and no reply writer for either
findingDetails.scopeProof: the eight reply sites are the complete set of hook_specific_output emitters in the declared target, and the four readStdin bodies are the complete set outside hook-io.mjs
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a shared reply writer and a shared stdin reader reachable from both trees

findingDetails.title: Three Vibe adapters have no test reference anywhere in the repository, and they are exactly the three that carry findings from this lineage
findingDetails.scopeProof: the search covered every *.test.* file under .vibe and .skilled; the three names return zero hits and the other nine return between one and eight
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: an adapter-level test for any of the three that names the file

results.summary: The binding census and the classification table were settled in iteration 3 and no binding changed. This iteration added no claim about the reference document.
The declared target is a file set, not a spec folder with a checklist.
prompt-advisor.mjs is named by the advisor test, so the advisor part carries a test even though the Vibe adapter is a symlink into the repo-guards tree.

The .skilled/hooks/*/vibe/ tree was checked for duplication against .vibe/plugins/repo-guards/: eleven of the twenty-two entries are symlinks into the repo-guards tree and the rest are real files with no counterpart there, so there is no second copy to drift.
No feature catalogue covers this file set.
No scenario file was read this iteration. Carried to the residual sweep.

noveltyJustification: weightedNew = 3 (three P2) against weightedTotal 19, the accumulated active set after this iteration (1 P1 = 5, 14 P2 = 14). No prior finding was refined or repeated: one is an import-guard defect, one is a duplicated-contract defect, and one is a coverage census. The iteration also converted a would-be duplication finding into a confirmed-clean surface after checking the symlinks.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: 27 hook and plugin files across two runtimes, with a test inventory that has to be measured by name rather than by directory because the adapters are split across two trees and eleven symlinks

targetSelection.selectionReason: the maintainability dimension's three questions: can an adapter be tested at all, does the reply contract live in one place, and which adapters have no test behind them

searchLedger.hypothesis: an entry point runs its hook at import time, so no test can import it

searchActions.queryOrPath: session-start.mjs:120-147 against turn-start.mjs:35,168 and turn-end.mjs:28,118 and compaction-post-tool.mjs:26,82
searchActions.result: session-start.mjs calls main() unconditionally at :145 and has no export; the other three guard the call behind IS_CLI_ENTRY and each has a test

searchLedger.rationale: the missing guard is the reason the file has no test, so the shape defect and the coverage gap are one defect

searchLedger.hypothesis: the reply shape and the stdin read are re-implemented per adapter instead of shared

searchActions.queryOrPath: hook_specific_output and function readStdin across the declared target
searchActions.result: eight reply sites and four byte-identical readStdin bodies; hook-io.mjs exports readPayload for the repo-guards tree and no reply writer exists for either tree

searchLedger.rationale: the contract has no home, which is the structural cause of R3-P2-002

searchLedger.hypothesis: an adapter has no test that names it

searchActions.queryOrPath: each adapter name across every *.test.* file under .vibe and .skilled
searchActions.result: deep-loop-guard, ask-surface-post-agent and completion-evidence-post-agent return zero hits; the other nine return between one and eight; the nearest tests import the core or the dsh adapter

searchLedger.rationale: the three untested adapters are the three that carry this lineage's findings

searchActions.result: six named sections (imports, constants, state, handoff pointer, detector, post-tool binding) and three exports (buildCompactionPart, measureJournal, buildPostToolPart)

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: the sections are cohesive and the size is the detector's, not a mix of concerns
